entry.label: Double-loop learning
entry.description: Double-loop learning changes not only an action but the governing assumptions, values or rules by which the action was chosen. It is distinguished from correcting performance while leaving those rules intact.
entry.canonical_definition: Learning that can question and alter governing values, assumptions, or organisational arrangements, rather than only improve action within them.

profile.title: Double-loop learning
profile.summary: Argyris distinguishes learning within an organisation's governing framework from inquiry that can change that framework.
profile.canonical_definition: Learning that can question and alter governing values, assumptions, or organisational arrangements, rather than only improve action within them.
profile.why_it_matters: A team can discuss reflection fluently while keeping the same behaviour.
key_distinctions: knowing the vocabulary versus changing conduct
practice_connections: Compare stated rules with recorded decisions and responses to challenge.
common_misreadings: A second feedback loop necessarily demonstrates double-loop learning.
open_checks: Check the conditions under which changed governing assumptions persist.
